T018 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YuiEucl n)),
  ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧ dimH E < ∞) ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → YuiContent s δ E < ∞) →
    dimH (YuiCylinder E) ≤ dimH E + 1 →
      (0 < dimH E → dimH E + 1 ≤ dimH (YuiCylinder E)) →
        (dimH E = 0 → 1 ≤ dimH (YuiCylinder E) ∧ 1 = dimH E + 1) → dimH (YuiCylinder E) = dimH E + 1
'Translation.T018' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
